notes: Posted 25 May 2001, five days before Tatooine's release; the author calls it a post-Tatooine version of his SC States winning deck and it uses Tatooine cards (Darth Maul, Maul's Lightsaber, Join Me!), so the format is Premiere - Tatooine.
Starting cards: the Objective (Set Your Course For Alderaan) and Prepared Defenses are in the list and count toward the 60; no starting Effect is named.

Author's corrections in the strategy: one 'Clash Of Sabers' (a Light card) is really You Are Beaten; there is no Battle Order in the deck (removed); the third weapon under 'Weapons(3)' is the Superlaser (added).
The posted list totals 60 before and after those corrections (Battle Order out, Superlaser in); the 'Effects(9)' header counts Battle Order, so 8 Effects remain.
Posted planets Yavin 4, Hoth, Fondor, Sullust, Endor, Alderaan dested the Dark system pages; 'Death Star Docking Bay' dested Death Star: Docking Bay 327 (Dark).

Posted '4-LOM w/ Gun' dested 4-LOM With Concussion Rifle; 'Mara's Stick' Mara Jade's Lightsaber; 'Maul's Stick' Maul's Lightsaber; 'Evader/Monok' Evader & Monnok; 'A Million Voices' A Million Voices Crying Out; 'SSPFT' Something Special Planned For Them; 'Dengar in P1' Dengar In Punishing One; 'Zuckuss in MH' Zuckuss In Mist Hunter.
Oppressive Enforcement and Come Here You Big Coward are 2001 Effects (Special Edition), not Defensive Shields.

The post calls this the deck that won the [[2001 South Carolina State Championship]], refined and modified with Tatooine cards; the list he posted the day before as played there is [[2001 South Carolina State Championship Brad Reinhold Things that go BOOM|Things that go BOOM]] (DeckTech 16165).
